name: Russian word list (CC BY 2.5)
content: Data files are derived from the University of Leeds Corpus (http://corpus.leeds.ac.uk/frqc/internet-ru.num) and distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/). Corpus editing and cleanup by hingston. sBoard includes the first 10,000 ranked Cyrillic-only entries, filters to alphabetic words of 2–40 letters, and assigns rank-derived scores. Source: https://github.com/hingston/russian/tree/b144235f90fc720ef310f304e31acc3825d62a1b
